title: Resolve stale Dependabot PRs to restore portfolio dependency freshness
council_summary: While the proposal leverages a portfolio-level statistic (13% of repositories with stale PRs) to justify action, the remediation itself is a localized, manual intervention on an external repository rather than an automated portfolio-wide feature. It is best to watch this or handle it via automated workflows.

title: Remediate high security vulnerability to uplift repository to Gold tier
council_summary: This proposal targets an external repository based on a valid cross-portfolio metric (7% of repositories failing Gold tier compliance). However, because it requires manual remediation on a single external repository rather than a platform-wide automation, we should watch it while prioritizing automated governance.
